seriesArc: A connected mystery series built around Forensics, Interrogation, Timeline, and Deduction.
subtitle: A Live Detective Mystery Experience
title: The First Lie
description: A clean starter mystery about a switched allergy-safe drink and one suspect whose timeline collapses under forensic review.
lobbyBackstory: Lena Broussard collapses during a crowded event. The crime scene team has already recovered the glass, photos, service-rail footage, phone records, and staff documents. Forensics returns processed reports as the investigation progresses.
rsvpExcerpt: A missing allergy marker turns a simple event death into a solvable first case.
openingNarration: The crime scene is processed. Review Forensics, challenge Interrogation, build the verified Timeline, and answer each Deduction.
revealScript: Tessa switched Lena’s marked allergy-safe drink for an unmarked praline cocktail. The blue pick, photo sequence, service-rail camera, and Tessa’s own statement all point to the same short window.

answerKey.method: She switched Lena’s allergy-safe marked drink with an unmarked praline cocktail after moving the blue allergy pick.
answerKey.motive: She feared Lena would replace her as lead event bartender.
answerKey.keyEvidence: The missing blue allergy pick, service-rail camera, before/after photos, and Tessa’s marker text.
answerKey.explanation: Tessa knew the marker mattered, stood alone at the rail during the switch window, and gave a statement contradicted by the verified timeline.

forensics.title: Recovered Glass Marker
forensics.text: The victim’s reserved cocktail glass was photographed with a blue allergy pick during setup. That marker identified Lena’s safe drink.

forensics.title: Before Photo: Blue Pick Visible
forensics.text: A guest photo taken before the toast shows the blue pick still standing in Lena’s glass.

forensics.title: Service Rail Isolation
forensics.text: Camera review shows Tessa alone at the service rail for nineteen seconds while two similar cocktails sit side by side.

forensics.title: Tessa’s Marker Text
forensics.text: Tessa texted, “I marked yours blue like always,” proving she knew the blue pick was Lena’s safety marker.

forensics.title: After Photo: Marker Missing
forensics.text: A second guest photo after the toast shows Lena holding a similar glass with no blue pick.

forensics.title: Drink Station Assignment
forensics.text: The staff sheet places Tessa on Lena’s drink station for the sponsor toast.

forensics.title: Blue Pick Recovered Under Rail
forensics.text: The missing blue pick was recovered under the service rail, not at Lena’s table.

forensics.title: Lena’s Phone Stayed at Table
forensics.text: Lena’s phone remained at her table during the service-rail window, supporting that someone else altered the drink.

forensics.title: Replacement Bartender Note
forensics.text: A recovered staff note says Lena was being considered for lead bartender after the event.

forensics.title: Hand Movement at the Rail
forensics.text: Enhanced footage shows Tessa’s hand move between the two glasses just before the blue pick disappears.

interrogation.title: Tessa Marchand
interrogation.text: Tessa says she marked Lena’s safe drink and never touched it again after placing it on the rail.

interrogation.title: Brielle Knox
interrogation.text: Brielle says she saw Tessa pull two glasses closer together while the toast line was forming.

interrogation.title: Cole Renard
interrogation.text: Cole says he was near the speakers and only noticed confusion after Lena reached for her drink.

interrogation.title: Mara Lee
interrogation.text: Mara says Lena always checked for the blue pick before drinking, but the toast happened too quickly.

interrogation.title: Tessa Follow-Up
interrogation.text: When asked about the lead bartender note, Tessa says Lena was not ready for that job.

timeline.title: Body Found / Emergency Called
timeline.text: Lena collapses shortly after the toast; emergency response begins.

timeline.title: Safe Drink Originally Marked
timeline.text: The recovered setup photo shows Lena’s safe drink marked with a blue allergy pick.

timeline.title: Tessa Alone at Service Rail
timeline.text: Camera footage places Tessa alone with the two similar cocktails.

timeline.title: Marker Missing After Toast
timeline.text: The after photo shows Lena’s glass without the blue marker.

timeline.title: Blue Pick Found Under Rail
timeline.text: The blue pick is recovered under the service rail, away from Lena’s table.

timeline.title: Switch Movement Confirmed
timeline.text: Enhanced footage shows Tessa’s hand moving between glasses during the switch window.
